objections.text: A01 supplies distinct StockItemID values in descending insertion order and therefore would expose the planted descending-order defect under the required ordered comparison. The adversarial plain-SQL assertions compare these rows as a multiset, despite spec.orderKey naming 'WWI Stock Item ID', so no input-only revision can catch the defect. Descending order is observable because the source query guarantees ascending order; it must not be recorded as equivalent. The harness needs to enforce the order key in adversarial assertions.
